summary: Resemblance stems and examples are also embedded in one šbḥ praise entry.
rationale: Permitted live entry lookup šbḥ returns the same I, II and III resemblance material with identical citations alongside distinct praise material. Keep the šbh proposal separate and reconcile the duplicated block editorially.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Lahdo Traitor 2/71)

data.turoyo: hani yaʕni hawxa lə kšəbhi noše, hawxa ksaymi mede hawxa.
data.translation: well, these, they do not look like people that would commit such actions.

rationale: Unusual zero-marked comparison standard; preserve the construction and ask whether l- is omitted.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NE Shangali Pangali/5)

data.turoyo: Omar, ‘Emáyxuno’. Ḥḏo məḷḷa li+ḥreto, ‘Ḥayra, latyo eman!’ ‘Šángali, Pángali, maʕ!’ Əmmi, ‘Lo, qolux lə+kšobah ldeman’.
data.translation: He says, ‘I’m your mother’. One said to the other, ‘Buddy, it’s not our mother!’ ‘Shangali, Pangali, baa!’ They say, ‘No, your voice doesn’t resemble our mother’s’.

rationale: Clear auditory resemblance context complements predominantly visual inherited examples.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (8/1)

data.turoyo: Tarte saʕat m d Ṣṭambəl lə kšəbhi l ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Nicht zwei Stunden in Stambul gleichen einander.

rationale: Short self-contained reciprocal comparison with temporal subjects.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (74/54)

data.turoyo: Zine, i kačke, d ḥəzyowayle b šanṯe, šəbhowayla bu šufro hiya ste.
data.translation: Sie war auch von ähnlicher Schönheit.

rationale: Thin I Infectum-wa/1; additional target suffix and respect b- beyond the first inherited token.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Talay 1/57)

data.turoyo: Ḥa mənne mḥele tre qamčirat ʕal riši, aq qamčirayḏe šəbhiwa l du ḥawlo. Məlle: "Baraz, tarbiyassəz, na štaġəla w ʕəmʕəm žta naye!"
data.translation: Daraufhin schlug mir einer zweimal mit der Peitsche auf den Kopf. Seine Peitschenschläge waren wie von einem dicken Seil. Dabei schimpfte er: „Du ungezogenes Schwein, sprich nicht mehr und ich will kein Stöhnen mehr von dir hören!“

rationale: Thin I Infectum-wa/1; nonhuman event subject.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (60/302)

data.turoyo: “Aman, ǧar bar malava! Ono zlam faqiro no, mayko kuḏʕatli?” Omər: “Imkan layto. Faqiro hat, samyo hat, bale kəmšabahnux bi laptayḏux i lapte d aḥuni Skandar. Kəmmatli, amalli. Lo kəmmatli gnoḥannux.”
data.translation: Jener sprach: "Erbarmen! Ich bin doch ein armer Mann, woher solltest du mich kennen?" "Es hilft nichts; du bist arm, du bist blind, aber deine Bewegungen gleichen denen meines Bruders Skändär. Wenn du es mir sagst, so sage es mir; sagst du es nicht, so werde ich dich abschlachten."

rationale: Thin II Infectum/1; experiencer compares a suffixed person and specifies movements with b-.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (66/233)

data.turoyo: Bakkoye ʕAwan koḥoyər. Hurək hurək kokorəx w kəmšabah, kale Mamme Ala se Sətya Zin yatiwo.
data.translation: Bakko Awan schaut sich sachte um, er geht herum, und es kommt ihm so vor, als ob Mamme Ala bei Sittiye Zin sitze.

rationale: Thin II Infectum/1; exemplifies already-listed den Eindruck haben, dass.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 1.5/80)

data.turoyo: Harke kḥuzeno u maṯlo d kobe u Ǧan b dukṯeyo. Yaʕni u Ṭuro w aḥ ḥaye du Ṭuro, kmašbahhe l dasto rabo w kul nošo ste, anǧax bi maġrafto kibe d moyəd mene!
data.translation: Here I see the example that Jan gives as being in its proper place. That is, Tur Abdin and the life of Tur Abdin, he likens it to a large cauldron, and each person, too, can only take from it with a ladle!

rationale: II Infectum has three examples after round 1; explicit likened object plus l-standard adds a clear extended comparison, preserving unusual kmašbahhe.

summary: I resemblance takes an ordinary subject and l-standard; reciprocal l ḥḏoḏe does not make the morphology Detransitive. I also already includes propositional seeming with d- (35/47), so 36/97 adds no sense.
II.1 already combines making similar, finding similar and having an impression. 60/302 and 66/233 provide previously thin experiential uses; no renumbering or translation-led split is needed.
29/334 contains two morphologically different targets, gməšbəh and gmitašbəh, already represented in I and III Detransitive boxes. Shared sentence context is not itself a duplicate target.
Lookup confirms missing žbh in this snapshot and duplicated resemblance material within šbḥ; absence of a lookup result does not justify deleting the cross-reference.
Incomplete and repaired comparisons in MAC YT LIFE STORY/61 and 77/127 do not establish xud or kəmmət as new verbal government.
Jan Beṯ-Şawoce has no edition translation. Supplied English is project machine translation, retained verbatim where quoted; semantic decisions rest on the Turoyo.

Round 1 already supplements II subjective comparison and impression; the Jan reader’s claim that II has only causative likening is obsolete. No independent II resemble sense is established merely from free English.
Jan 2.12/2818 mšabəh u lebo d Aloho may express resemblance or being pleasing to God; unmarked heart and biblical wording require confirmation. Withhold a new construction.

Jan 4.II/702 mažbəhowa lə ḥḏoḏe has reciprocal resemblance, but initial mažb- does not securely distinguish I Detransitive, II or a spelling variant. Preserve it in notes; no new II Infectum-wa box is asserted.
The round-1 duplicate resemblance block under šbḥ and unresolved žbh cross-reference remain prior editorial issues; do not repeat their correction in the round-2 JSON.
Reconcile duplicated resemblance material under šbḥ while preserving its distinct praise stems, and resolve the intended žbh cross-reference.
Check whether prs 26/14,36 in the inherited formula reflects a numbering difference or miscitation against supplied PrS 11/9, /14 and /20; no citation is changed without that check.
At 84/35 verify source i tašbiha versus glossary l-tašbiha. Is tašbiha a lexical comparison noun or a productive Infinitiv? No nominal box is published.
At Lahdo Traitor 2/71 is noše a zero-marked standard or a reduced clause? At 60/302 clarify whether i lapte d aḥuni is the standard or an apposition.
Confirm the I versus III Detransitive paradigms in 29/334 and feminine agreement with overt qayso at 62/282.
Confirm kmašbahhe at Jan 1.5/80 as II and identify the singular resumptive referent of coordinated Ṭuro plus its life.
At Jan 2.12/2818 does mšabəh u lebo d Aloho mean resembling or pleasing God’s heart? Is the predicate actually šbh or the adjacent praise root?
Confirm mažbəhowa at Jan 4.II/702 before claiming a new II form/sense; compare inherited I/III Detransitive resemblance.
Resolve ʕayn laṯe at Jan 3.7/82; no new comparison government is published from it.
Similarity covers voices, playing styles, actions, temporal intervals and scripts as well as physical appearance. l- and suffixed l-comparisons remain distinct from subject coding.
Resemblance ranges across mistaken human identity, buildings, abstract affairs and human/sheep analogy; these continue the round-1 participant range.
